source_text: On risk compensation, systematic reviews and meta-analyses of post-circumcision cohorts report no substantial increase in risky behaviors; a 2021 analysis of 28 studies found higher-quality evidence showing neutral or reduced risk profiles, with circumcised men often reporting safer practices due to counseling.
